jurisdiction of the Administrative Headquarters and Urban Centers of the State and matters connected there with or incidental there t oWhereas, it is expedient to provide for preservation, protection, regulation and maintenance of Government land meant for development of towns and settlements and other ecological sites of the State and more specifically within the jurisdiction of the Administrative Headquarters and Urban Centers of the State and to protect such land and ecological sites from unauthorized encroachers, wanton earth cutting, encroachment for habitation in the manner here in after
